notes.title: NEW 🔥 Arena Mode 🏹
notes.content:
This mode challenges you ⚔️
Within two minutes you have to withstand a continuous wave of enemies. They have a full arsenal of weapons that you could see in the main game. Axes, bows and spears. 
The main feature of this mode is that we have created new mechanics. Now time passes in real time, slowing down when pulling the bowstring. 
Feel a new range of emotions and go to the end to face the final bosses 🤛🏻
At the moment, we have prepared one arena and several more levels are already in development. You will receive a medal for successful completion, so go for it 🏅

notes.title: Let's improve our game 🏹
notes.content:
We have redesigned the axe for better recognition. Now you can throw it more accurately and kill the enemy while holding it in your hands! 
Also now you can catch spears and use it against your rivals
Fixed a bug that caused the bow to get stuck when moving between levels
And we added new function! Enable/disable postprocessing button added to the menu
By disable postprocessing you can increase FPS

In addition, new game modes are waiting for you in future updates 🫶🏻 
We hear your feedback and are happy to improve the game according to your requests
